questions.question: In union president election in a college between two candidates, the winner secured 85% of the total votes cast and wins by a margin of 5600 votes. How many votes did the losing candidate get?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

the winner secured 85% of the total votes cast and wins by a majority of 5600 votes

**Calculation:**

let 100% be the total votes cast

the winner secured 85% of the total votes cast,

Winning Candidate = 85%

Losing Candidate = 15%

Winning Candidate wins by a majority of 5600 votes,

Winning Candidate - Losing Candidate = 5600

85% - 15% = 5600

70% = 5600

1% = 80

Losing Candidate got 15%

15% = 15 × 80

= 1200 votes

**Answer is 1200.**

questions.question: The difference between cost price and selling price is Rs. 143. If profit percentage is 26 percent, then what is the selling price?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The difference between the Selling Price and Cost Price is the Profit.

Profit = 26% of Cost Price ⇒ 26 units = Rs. 143

Selling Price = 100% (CP) + 26% (Profit) = 126 units

Selling Price = (143 ÷ 26) × 126 = 11 × 63 = 693

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 693.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between Cost Price (CP) and Selling Price (SP) = Profit = Rs. 143

Profit percentage = 26%

 Cost Price (100%) Profit (26%) Rs. 143 
• 
• 
• Selling Price (126%) = Rs. 693 Profit and Loss Visualisation 

**Formula Used:**

Profit = (Profit% ÷ 100) × CP

SP = CP + Profit

**Calculations:**

⇒ 143 = (26 ÷ 100) × CP

⇒ CP = (143 × 100) ÷ 26

⇒ CP = 11 × 50

⇒ CP = Rs. 550

⇒ SP = CP + Profit

⇒ SP = 550 + 143

⇒ SP = Rs. 693

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 693.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Basics

Profit occurs when the Selling Price (SP) is greater than the Cost Price (CP). Thus, Profit = SP − CP. Conversely, a loss happens when CP is greater than SP.

Profit Percentage Base

Profit and loss percentages are always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless the question specifically mentions calculating it on the Selling Price. Formula: Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

Direct Selling Price Formula

When the cost price and profit percentage are known, the selling price can be directly calculated using the multiplier formula: SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100.

questions.question: A retailer purchased a batch of goods for ₹5,000. Due to a manufacturing defect, 5% of the goods were damaged. If the retailer wants to make a profit of 20% on the remaining goods, at what price should the undamaged goods be sold?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹5,000

Damaged goods = 5%

Profit = 20%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price of undamaged goods + Desired Profit

**Calculations:**

Damaged goods = 5% of 5000

⇒ Damaged goods = 0.05 × 5000 = ₹250

Undamaged goods cost = 5000 - 250

⇒ Undamaged goods cost = ₹4750

Desired profit = 20% of undamaged goods cost

⇒ Desired profit = 0.20 × 4750 = ₹950

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price of undamaged goods + Desired Profit

⇒ SP = 4750 + 950 = ₹5700

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: Price of rice is increased by 25%. By how much percent should a household reduce its monthly consumption of rice to keep its monthly expenditure on rice constant?
questions.solution:
**Formula Used:**

Expenditure = Consumption × Price

⇒ Consumption = Expenditure ÷ Price

**Calculation:**

Increase in price of rice = 25%

⇒ Consumption = 100/125 = 0.8

Decrease in consumption = 1 - 0.8 = 0.2

**Hence, the reduction in monthly consumption is 20%.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Let the original price be Rs. 100

Increase in the price of rice = 25 % of the original price = Rs. 25

The new price of rice = Rs 100 + Rs. 25 = Rs. 125

In order to not to increase the expenditure, the family needs to reduce the consumption.

The reduction has by the same amount that is Rs.25.

Percentage reduction in consumption = ( 25 /125 ) × 100 = 20 %

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Here, 25 % = 1/4

If expenditure is same, then consumption will be the reverse of price.

Price 4 ------> 5

Consumption 5 ------> 4

∴ Reduction in consumption = (1/5 ) × 100 = 20%

questions.question: The difference between the compound interest (compounding annually) and simple interest on a sum at the rate of 30 percent per annum for 2 years is Rs. 3600. What is the sum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years is given directly by the formula:

Difference = P × (R / 100)²

3600 = P × (30 / 100)²

3600 = P × (9 / 100) ⇒ P = 40000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 40000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate of Interest (R) = 30% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

Difference between CI and SI = Rs. 3600

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2b5620dd21648c6c1e52f210c7ca4bd851c2ceb5f8ed3540bf41c2bb9e7fdff.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Effective Simple Interest rate for 2 years = 30% × 2 = 60%

⇒ Effective Compound Interest rate for 2 years = X + Y + (X × Y) / 100

⇒ Effective CI rate = 30% + 30% + (30 × 30) / 100 % = 69%

⇒ Difference in percentage = 69% − 60% = 9%

⇒ According to the question, 9% of the Principal corresponds to Rs. 3600

⇒ 1% of Principal = 3600 ÷ 9 = 400

⇒ Total Sum (100% Principal) = 400 × 100 = 40000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 40000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Compound Interest

For 2 years, the effective CI rate can be found using successive percentage formula: [2R + (R² ÷ 100)]%. The term (R² ÷ 100)% directly gives the difference between CI and SI in percentage.

Difference for 3 Years

The difference between CI and SI for 3 years is calculated using the standard formula: Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)² × (3 + R ÷ 100).

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is calculated only on the principal, whereas Compound Interest is calculated on the principal and also on the accumulated interest of previous periods, which creates the difference over time.

questions.question: Vikram saves 13% of his monthly salary. If his monthly expenditure is Rs. 5,220, then his monthly savings is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Monthly expenditure = Rs. 5,220.

Savings percentage = 13%.

**Formula Used:**

Savings = Salary × Savings percentage.

Expenditure + Savings = Salary.

**Calculation:**

Let the monthly salary be Rs. x.

⇒ Expenditure + Savings = Salary

⇒ Rs. 5,220 + 0.13x = x

⇒ 0.13x = x - Rs. 5,220

⇒ 0.13x = x - 5,220

⇒ 0.13x = 1x - 5,220

⇒ 5,220 = (1 - 0.13)x

⇒ 5,220 = 0.87x

⇒ x = 5,220 / 0.87

⇒ x = Rs. 6,000

So, the monthly savings = 0.13 × 6,000

⇒ Rs. 780

The monthly savings is Rs. 780.&

questions.question: A waiter's income consists of his salary and tips. During one week, his tips were 5/4 of his salary. What fraction of his income came from tips?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Tips to Salary = 5 : 4

Total Income = Tips + Salary = 5 + 4 = 9 units

Fraction of income from tips = Tips ÷ Total Income = 5/9

**∴ The correct answer is 5/9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Tips = 5/4 × Salary

Total Income = Salary + Tips

**Formula:**

Fraction of tips = Tips ÷ (Salary + Tips)

 
 
 Salary (4)
 Tips (5)
 
• 
 Total Income = 9 Units
 Fraction of Tips = 5 ÷ 9

Let Salary = 4x

⇒ Tips = 5/4 × 4x = 5x

⇒ Total Income = 4x + 5x = 9x

⇒ Fraction of income from tips = 5x ÷ 9x

⇒ Fraction = 5/9

**∴ The correct answer is 5/9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio to Fraction

If the ratio of two parts A and B is a:b, the fraction of A in the whole (A+B) is a/(a+b) and the fraction of B is b/(a+b).

Percentage Calculation

To convert the fraction of tips into a percentage, multiply by 100. Example: (5/9) × 100 ≈ 55.55%.

Proportion Rule

If A = (m/n) × B, then the ratio A:B is m:n. Here, Tips = (5/4) × Salary, so Tips:Salary = 5:4.</p

questions.question: Before two years, the ratio of the age of Raja and Kiran was 7 : 5. After 6 years from now, the ratio of their ages are 9 : 7. Find the present average age of both of them.
questions.solution:
Given:

Before two years, the ratio of the age of Raja and Kiran was 7 : 5.

After 6 years from now, the ratio of their ages are 9 : 7.

Calculation:

Two years ago:

Age of Raja = 7x

Age of Kiran = 5x

Present age:

Age of Raja = 7x + 2

Age of Kiran = 5x + 2

After 6 years (from the present):

Age of Raja = 7x + 2 + 6 = 7x + 8

Age of Kiran = 5x + 2 + 6 = 5x + 8

According to the question,

⇒ (7x+8)/(5x+8) = (9)/(7)

⇒ 49x + 56 = 45x + 72

⇒ 4x = 72 - 56

⇒ 4x = 16

⇒ x = 4

Present age:

Age of Raja = 7 × 4 + 2 = 30

Age of Kiran = 5 × 4 + 2 = 22

Average of present age = (30+22)/(2) = 26 years

∴ '26 years' is the required answer

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Before x years, the ratio of the age of Raja and Kiran was A : B. After y years from now, the ratio of their ages are C : D. 

The ratio of the age after y years = (Ak + x + y)/(Bk + x + y) = (C)/(D)

According to the question,

⇒ (7k + 2 + 6)/(5k + 2 + 6) = (9)/(7)

⇒ (7k + 8)/(5k + 8) = (9)/(7)

⇒ 49k + 56 = 45k + 72

⇒ 4k = 16

⇒ k = 4

Two years ago:

Age of Raja = 7k = 28

Age of Kiran = 5k = 20

Present age:

Age of Raja = 28 + 2 = 30

Age of Kiran = 20 + 2 = 22

Average of present age = (30+22)/(2) = 26 years

∴ '26 years' is the required answer.**.**

Time required for one woman to complete work

Y's marks = 480

X got 40% more marks than Y.

X got 20% less marks than Z.

X's marks = Y's marks × (1 + 40/100)

Z's marks = X's marks / (1 - 20/100)

**Calculation:**

X's marks = 480 × 1.4

⇒ X's marks = 672

Z's marks = 672 / 0.8

⇒ Z's marks = 840
